interfaces.label: Backplane connector
interfaces.desc: Plugs into a backplane slot. Carries CAN, 3.3 V and 5 V.

interfaces.label: ST-Link
interfaces.desc: Programming and debug port (JTAG/SWD) with the ST-Link UART.

interfaces.label: GNSS module A
interfaces.desc: Board-to-board connector for the GNSS module: switched 3.3 V, UART, RTK status and geofence status.

interfaces.label: GNSS module B
interfaces.desc: Board-to-board connector for the GNSS module: switched 3.3 V, reset, interrupt, timepulse and safeboot.

interfaces.label: LoRa antenna
interfaces.desc: Antenna port of the NiceRF LoRa1278F30 module.

interfaces.label: External connector
interfaces.desc: For external add-ons: switched 3.3 V and 5 V, SPI with three chip selects, I²C and UART.

interfaces.label: RTD 1
interfaces.desc: 3-wire RTD temperature probe, read by a MAX31865 over SPI.

interfaces.label: RTD 2
interfaces.desc: 3-wire RTD temperature probe, read by a MAX31865 over SPI.

interfaces.label: RTD 3
interfaces.desc: 3-wire RTD temperature probe, read by a MAX31865 over SPI.

interfaces.label: RTD 4
interfaces.desc: 3-wire RTD temperature probe, read by a MAX31865 over SPI.

interfaces.label: RTC battery
interfaces.desc: Backup battery for the real-time clock of the MCU.

interfaces.label: VBAT select
interfaces.desc: Jumper 1-2 feeds the MCU VBAT pin from the RTC battery, 2-3 from the main 3.3 V rail.
